speaker: Sheldon
text: What is it about the word unique you don't understand? There's Neosporin and band-aids in my top desk drawer.

speaker: Howard
text: Ow! Paper cut, nothing worse than a paper cut. You keep that stuff in the bathroom.

speaker: Leonard
text: Well, obviously you don't remember your circumcision. He does, and in the kitchen, and in the car, and in his pocket.

speaker: Sheldon
text: But the ones in my pocket are mine.

speaker: Howard
text: Hey, guess who's gonna be at the comic book store on Thursday?

speaker: Penny
text: Hi. Um, can you give me a hint? Um, Stan Lee, Stan Lee, Stanley Tucci?

speaker: Howard
text: Stan Lee.

speaker: Howard
text: No, no, Stan Lee.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, oh, Stan Lee, cool.

speaker: Howard
text: You have no idea who he is, do you?

speaker: Penny
text: Of course I do. You're an important part of my life, and I pay attention to the things you are interested in.

speaker: Howard
text: Good, good. So, who's Stan Lee?

speaker: Penny
text: Um, he was on Star Trek.

speaker: Howard
text: Nope.

speaker: Penny
text: Star Wars? Um, oh, Stan Lee. Oh, he was in those goofy kung fu movies you love so much.

speaker: Howard
text: That's Bruce Lee.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, so is this Bruce Lee's nerdy brother Stan?

speaker: Howard
text: Well then, why do you have all these unopened paychecks in your desk?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Because most of the things I'm planning to buy haven't been invented yet.

speaker: Howard
text: There must be thousands of dollars here. Why don't you put it in the bank?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I don't trust banks. I believe that when the robots rise up, ATMs will lead the charge.

speaker: Howard
text: You've also got something from the Pasadena Municipal Court.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Undoubtedly, yet another snide response to my repeated letters complaining that the flags in front of the courthouse are flying in the wrong order. From left to right, it's supposed to be federal, state, and then city of Pasadena.

speaker: Penny
text: I'm sorry, you said more than one letter about that?

speaker: Sheldon
text: It bothers me.

speaker: Howard
text: Gentlemen, this is a summons.

speaker: Sheldon
text: A summons? For what?

speaker: Howard
text: Looks like you ran a red light on Marengo Avenue at 9:30 p.m. on November 16th. I got you on a traffic camera. Nice picture.
